pages.title: A Standing Offer
pages.text: Right-click The Hunger's Pact and a small menu opens - a standing offer of permanent upgrades, each paid for with more Arcane Ink. Nothing about it is one-time; open it again whenever you've saved up more.

pages.title: Mana Boost
pages.text: Raises the max mana of every Magic Lens you own, up to 3 levels. Buying a level applies immediately to lenses you're already carrying, and any lens crafted afterward starts with the bonus already built in.

pages.title: Cooldowns & Costs
pages.text: Both repeat up to 5 levels each, each level shaving a further 5% off spellcasting cooldowns or mana costs respectively - up to 25% off at full investment. Later levels cost more ink than earlier ones.

pages.title: Pocket Dimension
pages.text: A one-time spell unlock, but gated: it only becomes purchasable once Mana Boost has reached at least level 1. Buy it and the spell is simply known from then on - no book, no hunting for it.
